description: Brings a picture, clip or song from a public link (for example a fal or Higgsfield output) into a video, and returns its asset_id for put_overlay, add_clip or set_audio. Clips up to 100 MiB, pictures and songs up to 32 MiB. Cost: Free: no credits.

name.description: A file name to keep it under.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

url.description: A public https link to a picture, clip or song (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV, M4A).

name: import_media

outputSchema.description: Clypmint import_media result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Bring in a file
